title: Chapter 437 Lu Xue Is Reassured
content:
Chapter 437 Lu Xue Is Reassured

"Is that the White Tiger? It's the same age as me."

Looking at Bai Xu from a distance, Qinghai spoke unconsciously.

On the side, Xuan Si nodded, "Yes, our generation not only gathered all the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon, but unexpectedly they were all younger generations. It's such a coincidence."

In the historical records of the Tiande Clan, there were times when the four heavenly demons gathered several times.

But the four symbols of the heavenly demons in those eras are not the same age.

Some are three older and one younger, some are three younger and one older, and some are two-way opposite each other.

And this situation will not take long before the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon will be vacant again.

But this time it is different. The four of them belong to the younger generation and will inevitably advance and retreat together in the future. Under the leadership of the four symbols of the Heavenly Demon Clan, they will inevitably return to their past glory.

However, these are all things that only happen under the conditions of a peaceful era.

And now, the Chaos Realm is really nothing to do with peace.

"elder brother!"

"younger sister!"

Bai Xu and Bai Ling hugged each other. This warm scene made Xuan Si lower his head slightly and secretly wipe his tears.

"It's really touching."

Qinghai cut it, but the corners of his mouth still couldn't help but raise slightly.

Just as the two were sighing at the relationship between the brother and sister, a figure suddenly flew out with a bang.

"Damn?"

Under the shocked gaze of the two, Bai Xu was already lying in the distance in a blink of an eye.

At this time, Bai Xu was also a little confused.

When the people passing by were shocked when they saw this scene, they actually felt that now, there are still people who dare to take action in the deserted city and don’t want to live anymore.

But there are also many people who stop and watch with the mentality of watching the fun.

The deserted guards will come soon, and the man and woman will be in trouble at that time.

But as time passed, everyone gradually frowned. Where is the Huangwei?

Is it because Huangwei is not at work today?

At this time, Bai Xu sat up from the ground, looked at Bai Ling who was walking towards him in a daze, and said blankly: "Sister, I am your brother, Bai Xu!"

But Bai Ling had tears in his eyes and choked a little, "You still know you are my brother!"

When he came to Bai Xu, Bai Ling frowned and cried while beating, "Didn't you say we will never be separated? Why should we leave me behind? Why, why!"

Listening to Bai Ling's crying, Bai Xu silently endured everything and did not dare to fight back at all.

He did all this for the future, so that he would not let the little guy take Bai Ling away from him in the future, and he did not want to lose his sister.

Therefore, he could only temporarily "abandon" Bai Ling, and only when he truly had the strength could he protect his sister forever.

But now, he really regrets it.

"Sister, it's brother, I'm sorry for you." Bai Xu suddenly spoke up against Bai Ling's unpainful attack.

Hearing his brother's words, Bai Ling's movements stopped. Looking at the brother in front of him, Bai Ling could no longer help but pounced on Bai Xu's arms, and burst into tears with a wow sound.

"Brother, don't leave me again in the future, okay?"

Looking at Bai Ling who was crying, Bai Xu felt ache in his heart, touched Bai Ling's head, and said gently, "Brother promises you that he will never leave you again in the future."

"good."

Slap!

On the side, Qinghai and Xuan Si approached and unconsciously clapped their hands.

"This situation really touched us."

Xuan Si's eyes were slightly red, and he shook his head and sighed.

Qinghai did not speak, but stared at Bai Xu with his sharp dragon eyes.

At this time, Bai Xu finally remembered that Senior Hao was talking about three people, so the two people in front of him were the other two four symbols except himself and his sister - Qinglong and Xuanwu.

"Brother, let me introduce you to you. This one is Qinghai, this one is,"

Before Bai Ling could finish his words, Xuan Si stepped forward enthusiastically and held Bai Xu's hand, nodded, "My name is Xuan Si, brother, we will be our own people in the future."

"Yes, my own people."

The four people looked at each other and laughed. In this way, the four symbols of the heavenly demon were completely gathered.

"Miss Bai Ling."

At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded beside him.

Bai Ling was slightly stunned and saw a figure in a black robe standing here, and there was already no one around.

"You are, root?"

The black robe nodded slightly and said, "Miss Bai Ling, Miss is waiting for you."

Hearing this, Bai Ling's face slightly stern, "I understand."

"Brother, you go with me too."

"Ah? Me?"

Bai Xu was shocked and dared not answer.

Miss, who else can you be? It must be that senior.

Even after a long time, Bai Xu still had no face to face Lu Xue.

But in the end, under Bai Ling's insistence, Bai Xu followed Bai Ling and the other two to the city lord's mansion.

Under the leadership of the members of the Gen Organization, Sixiang soon arrived at the City Lord's Mansion.

The moment he stepped into the city lord's mansion, an inexplicable sense of oppression came over him.

"I really didn't expect that I could actually enter the city lord's mansion when I came to Huangcheng for the first time."

Qinghai took a deep breath and stepped into the city lord's mansion.

On the side, Xuan Si chuckled and said, "This is all for the blessing of Sister Bai Ling."

Bai Xu swallowed unconsciously and followed Bai Ling silently.

As if Bai Xu's nervousness was seen, Bai Ling reached out and held Bai Xu's arm.

Bai Xu replied to Bai Ling with a reluctant smile, and soon the four of them arrived in front of the courtyard where Lu Xue was.

"Miss Lu Xue, Miss Bai Ling is back."

The black-robed figure bent into the courtyard, his tone was extremely respectful.

Soon, a somewhat majestic voice came from the courtyard, "I understand, let them in."

"yes."

A squeak.

The door opened, and a blue figure was lying on the chair slightly lazy, with his eyes slightly closed.

Bai Xu didn't dare to breathe, and lowered his head tightly, not daring to see Lu Xue.

Qinghai and Xuansi's heartbeat for no reason and couldn't help but feel nervous.

In comparison, Bai Ling is much normal.

I saw her approaching respectfully, bowing slightly, and whispering: "Senior."

Lu Xue slowly opened her eyes and looked at Bai Ling without looking at the three people behind Bai Ling. "What's wrong with the Heavenly Demon Clan?"

Bai Ling lowered his head and said, "The Heavenly Demon Clan will take all its strength after agreeing, but there is no reservation."

"Lord Ao Qing chose to stay in the Heavenly Demon Clan for the time being, and help the Heavenly Demon Clan improve its strength in a short period of time to deal with the war that will not be long."

Hearing Bai Ling’s report, Lu Xue’s eyes were filled with surprise, “Is Xiaoqing really that true?”

Bai Ling's face did not change and nodded slightly.

At least, Ao Qing did say that before leaving. As for whether he would do this, she didn't know.

Seeing this, Lu Xue sat up directly, with a little smile on her face.

"So many years have passed, I thought Xiaoqing would always be the kind of virtue, but I didn't expect,

Lu Xue shook her head and smiled, then glanced at the three people behind Bai Ling.
